description: Get selected fields for EVERY asset on one date in a single call (about 11,000 rows), ordered by ticker: the input of a daily or weekly trading model run. Fields use the same names as get_search and are tier-gated the same way; at most 60 per call. Costs 5 credits per 10 fields. member_of / held_by restrict it to an index's or a fund's holdings on that date ("S&P 500 members with garp_core_score"). A row dated D reflects everything known by 04:00 UTC on D+1, so a backtest acts at the next session's open. For filtered or ranked subsets use get_search; for one ticker use get_summary.

asset_class.description: Only this asset class. Omit for all.

date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for each asset class's newest published date. History depth depends on plan.

fields.description: Fields to return, e.g. ["trend_direction", "momentum_rsi_zone", "market_cap_usd"]. Same names and aliases as get_search; at most 60.

held_by.description: Only assets this fund held on each row's date: fund ticker (e.g. "IVV", "ARKK") or SEC series id (find with get_funds). Point in time like member_of.

member_of.description: Only members of this index on each row's date, e.g. "sp500", "nasdaq100", "russell2000" (list: get_indexes). Point in time: the tracking fund's N-PORT portfolio public on that date (typically 2-5 months old).

timeframe.description: daily, or weekly (Sunday-dated). Daily snapshots are Pro and Commercial only (Free and Plus read weekly; daily returns 403). Default: daily on Pro and Commercial, weekly on Free and Plus

name: get_universe

data.description: The TickerDB API response payload for this tool call.
